t: What he told the young men after twenty nights
a: ارْجِعُوا إِلَى أَهْلِيكُمْ فَعَلِّمُوهُمْ وَمُرُوهُمْ، وَصَلُّوا كَمَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي أُصَلِّي
p: Irjiʿū ilā ahlīkum fa-ʿallimūhum wa murūhum, wa ṣallū kamā raʾaytumūnī uṣallī
m: Go back to your families, and teach them and instruct them, and pray as you have seen me pray.
